window_discipline.baseline: three samples within 5 minutes before the capture; baseline_free = min(free) (sampling rule: worst of the three; separate from the signed/onspot merge)
window_discipline.onspot_floor: baseline_free - 3072 MiB computed on the spot
window_discipline.signed_floor_stricter_wins: floor_effective = max(user-signed floor, onspot floor); acceptance is free >= floor_effective, so a HIGHER floor is stricter (min would relax it)
window_discipline.monitor: monitor-until-clean.ps1 -Required 60 -MaxMinutes 30 -MaxUtil 40; exit 0, 60/60 util<40, compute_filtered=0, build=0; no other CUDA process during the monitor; internal 10,240 MiB is only a lower bound

authoring_exception.scope: capture window (G-L1) only; regular util<40 not met => authoring-only util<60, every sample recorded
authoring_exception.limits: still requires the S-2 dual signature before opening; not applicable to the pilot or the validation window; does not relax the floor; fail-stop, no retry

window_discipline.zero_compile: build before the window and record the fingerprint; no cargo/nvcc inside; warp JIT expected

post_capture_checks: two captures bitwise identical (per-file sha256; capture.json flag)
C1 cam-persp both world pairs >=576 (max_channel |delta rgb| >= 1/255)
C2 cam-hinge depth bit-change and seg pair-change both pairs >=576
section 2.4 counts in capture.json equal the readout counters for both world pairs item by item (entity check_capture_c1 adapted to the dict structure)
metadata four items + dual-camera snapshot (nrender==2 / cam_id_map==[0,1] / cam_res==[[320,240],[320,240]] / recipe.cameras 2x10 fields)
seg visible (id,type) sets per world per camera
[384,576) insufficient margin => stop; <384 non-discriminating => refuse; commit only on full pass
